title: A truncation criterion for compactness in asymptotic $L_p$ spaces
summary: We prove a compactness criterion for asymptotic $L_p$ spaces over arbitrary measure spaces. Total boundedness is characterized by almost equiboundedness together with total boundedness in $L_p$ of all truncations. As a consequence, we obtain a simpler proof of the Kolmogorov--Riesz compactness theorem for asymptotic $L_p$ spaces on $\mathbb R^n$.
